description: The line plot, titled "Training Loss of 20M Data Size," illustrates the training loss over steps for five different models—ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBART Medium 20M, ChemBERTa Small 20M, ChemBERTa Medium 20M, and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M—trained on a dataset of 20 million samples. The x-axis, labeled "Step," represents the number of training steps, ranging from 0k to 440k, with major tick marks at intervals of 20k. The y-axis, labeled "Train Loss," measures the training loss, scaled from 0.0 to 0.85. The plot shows that all models begin with a high training loss, with the ChemBART Small 20M (red line) starting at approximately 0.85 and the ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown line) starting at around 0.75. All models exhibit a rapid initial decrease in loss, with the ChemBERTa Small 20M (green line) showing the most significant drop, reaching a loss of about 0.2 by 20k steps. After this initial phase, the loss for all models continues to decrease more gradually, converging to a range between 0.1 and 0.2 by 40k steps. The lines remain closely clustered for the remainder of the training, with the ChemBERTa models (green and orange) generally maintaining a slightly lower loss than the ChemBART and ChemLLaMA models. The plot includes a zoomed-in view of the final 20k steps, highlighting the fine-grained behavior of the loss curves as they stabilize.
